_readme: One list per start date; the newest whose date has arrived (player's local time) is today's. kind 'country' turns on country spell-checking and suggestions. aliases are extra accepted spellings; for people, a unique surname is accepted automatically. close = ranks just outside the top 10 (people/film lists); rest = every ranked country beyond #10 (country lists), so misses show their real rank (still a miss, but the game says how close). free = guesses that get a note and don't cost a miss.
